# st-zentao Provider

Provider for ZenTao (self-hosted open-source / Pro / Biz / Max). Requires url, account, and password; account/password fall back to ZENTAO_ACCOUNT and ZENTAO_PASSWORD env vars.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    st-zentao = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/myklst/st-zentao"
    }
  }
}

provider "st-zentao" {
  url      = "http://localhost:8080"
  account  = "admin"
  password = "P@ssw0rd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Base URL of the ZenTao instance (e.g. https://zentao.example.com).

### Optional

- `account` (String, Sensitive) ZenTao account name. Falls back to ZENTAO_ACCOUNT env var.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) ZenTao account password. Falls back to ZENTAO_PASSWORD env var.
